text:
mara: kicking off the staged deploy for the API/runtime/router bundle. planned canary sequence 10% -> 50% -> 100% inside the 02:00-04:00 UTC window. pin config coming.

deploybot: deploy job queued by mara. id=deploy-1769009999. canary policy: 10m evaluation, rollback on 3x error rate spike or latency +50% for 5m.

mara: pin set in the deploy manifest:
`api: v3.4.1`
`runtime: 1.10.0-rc2`
`router: 2.4.0`
please don't advance router until runtime canary green (interlock).

kai: noted. i'll hold router pin until runtime signals healthy. what's the fallback variant if runtime fails? want a quick rollback plan.

serena: fallback plan: if runtime canary fails, automatic rollback to runtime 1.9.8 (current stable), router remains pinned to previous routing rules. ops will cut traffic to dedicated lane and revert api to v3.4.0 if needed.

leo: adding manual approval gate at 50% canary. i'm on pager and can squash if we see mem spikes. logging: link to runbook https://confluence.redwood/ops/runbooks/staged-deploy

mara: release notes posted (short list): schema bump for chat tokens, new kv eviction tweak, telemetry tags. small breaking in admin console UI behind feature flag.

ops-bot: Preflight checks: infra quota OK, downstream deps status OK, secrets present. Canary bucket ready: eu-west-1 (10%), us-east-1 (fallback). artifactory: images pushed.

kai: running a quick smoke on router v2.4.0 with runtime-rc2 on a dev shard, no obvious regressions. CPU up ~5% under p50 qps.

serena: re: rollback criteria — suggest we add a traffic hedge rule at 20% for first 10m to reduce blast radius. mara ok with that?

mara: yes please add hedge. update manifest snippet:
`canary: [10% for 10m, 20% hedge for 10m, 50% manual]`

deploybot: updated. canary plan saved to deploy-1769009999. automated rollback hooks armed.

leo: i'm standing by for the 10% flip. once green i'll manually sign the 50% advance. tagging @kai for router advance after ops signoff.

kai: copy. will only advance router after confirmation from leo and ops-bot returns green.

mara: final check: changelog link https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/1769009999, i've attached config and short QA checklist.

ops-bot: 02:00 UTC - canary flip to 10% executed.

leo: 02:10 UTC - monitoring looks healthy. error budget usage nominal. no elevated 5xx.

mara: preparing to request manual 50% advance. leo please approve when ready.

leo: approved. advancing to 50% now.

deploybot: traffic at 50%. monitoring window started. alert thresholds active.

kai: advancing router pin to 2.4.0 in 2m.

serena: all green on my side. will watch for mem and GC regressions for 30m.

mara: thanks team. final rollout to 100% scheduled for 03:00 UTC unless we see regressions. if anything smells off, abort and revert to runtime 1.9.8 + router previous.

leo: noted. keeping pager on. :thumbsup:

deploybot: deploy-1769009999 completed to 100% at 03:05 UTC. post-deploy checks passed. closing thread.
